title: Adobe MAX Miami: Every Major AI Tool, Creative Agent & Local MCP Update Announced
summary: At Adobe MAX in Miami Beach, Adobe unveiled a monumental shift toward agentic AI: introducing the Adobe Creative Agent, local Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Photoshop & Premiere, 3D Relight, in-timeline Generative Media, and a Disney innovation partnership.
content:
At Adobe MAX in Miami Beach, Adobe unveiled one of the most consequential transformations in Creative Cloud history. The company officially pivoted from simple generative prompt widgets to an integrated agentic ecosystem—introducing the Adobe Creative Agent, local Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for third-party AI agents, virtual 3D Relight in Photoshop, in-timeline generative video tools in Premiere Pro, and an expanded Firefly AI Creative Studio.

Here is the comprehensive, deep-dive breakdown of every major tool, feature, and architectural shift announced at Adobe MAX Miami.

### 1. The Adobe Creative Agent: Multi-Step Conversational Creative Partner

Adobe introduced the **Adobe Creative Agent**, an AI-powered conversational partner built directly into Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects.

• **Multi-Step Execution**: Instead of manually executing dozens of repetitive steps, creators can command the Creative Agent in natural language (e.g., *'Resize this banner for 5 social formats, swap the background to a sunset beach, and harmonize the typography with our brand guide'*).
• **Native File Manipulation**: Unlike web wrappers that export flat raster files, the Creative Agent works natively within project files, creating non-destructive adjustment layers, vector shapes, masks, and editable text layers.
• **Cross-App Orchestration**: The agent can coordinate assets across multiple apps—generating vector iconography in Illustrator, placing them onto Photoshop canvas layouts, and importing the final composites into Premiere Pro sequences.

### 2. Third-Party AI Agents & Local Model Context Protocol (MCP)

In what industry observers called a historic strategic opening, Adobe previewed **local Model Context Protocol (MCP)** integrations for Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.

• **Connect Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini to Desktop Apps**: Creators can connect their preferred frontier AI models (such as Claude 3.5/5.2 or ChatGPT) directly to Adobe desktop software running on their local machines.
• **Bi-Directional Context & Control**: External agents can read canvas layer hierarchies, inspect vector anchor paths, and generate or modify project elements locally over MCP without uploading raw project files to cloud servers.
• **Zero Loss of Editability**: All changes made by connected MCP agents remain fully layered, non-destructive, and editable by human artists.

### 3. Photoshop: 3D Relight & Generative Restyle (General Availability)

Adobe graduated two major generative features from public beta into the core Photoshop release:

• **Photoshop Relight**: Creators can realistically add and reposition up to three virtual 3D light sources inside a 2D photograph after it has been shot. Users can modify light position in 3D space, beam radius, color temperature, and surface falloff. The lighting effect renders onto its own dedicated, non-destructive layer, allowing infinite tweaks before committing generative credits.
• **Generative Restyle**: Completely transforms image mood, aesthetic style, and artistic medium using natural language prompts. It features a real-time intensity slider in the Properties panel, allowing artists to seamlessly blend the restyled aesthetic between 0% and 100% without re-generating.
• **Enhanced Remove Tool**: Upgraded distraction detection automatically isolates and eliminates complex background elements, wires, and unwanted people with seamless in-painting.

### 4. Premiere Pro: In-Timeline Generative Media & Dedicated Color Mode

Video editors received substantial workflow upgrades designed to eliminate blank timeline gaps:

• **In-Timeline Generative B-Roll**: Editors can generate custom 1080p B-roll and atmospheric filler footage directly from the timeline without leaving Premiere Pro.
• **Generative Audio & Soundscapes**: Premiere Pro can now synthesize ambient soundscapes, targeted sound effects (Foley), and background musical scores matched to video edit points.
• **Dedicated Color Mode (General Availability)**: Formally graduated to general availability, providing an unified, intuitive color workspace from instant auto-correction to sophisticated HDR lumetri grading.

### 5. Firefly AI Creative Studio & Firefly Design

Adobe expanded Firefly from an image generator into a full-fledged creative production suite:

• **Firefly Design (Beta)**: A unified, infinite canvas combining raster photography, vector art, motion graphics, 3D assets, and print layouts into a single collaborative workspace.
• **Firefly Graph (Beta)**: Node-based visual scripting allowing teams to construct repeatable, automated production pipelines.
• **Design-to-Code Prototyping**: Instant conversion of visual mockups into functional web and mobile application prototypes.

### 6. Disney Innovation Partnership & Enterprise GenStudio

• **Disney Official AI Innovation Partner**: Adobe announced that Disney has selected Adobe Firefly as its official AI innovation partner to explore creative production workflows.
• **Adobe GenStudio for Enterprise**: Deep integration of the Creative Agent into enterprise marketing pipelines to generate, brand-check, and distribute localized campaigns across global teams.
